class.name: Lifetime
class.brief_description: Frees its parent after some time.
class.description: When the time runs out, frees its parent (or itself if [member free_parent] is [code]false[/code]). Add it to bullets, effects or debris so they disappear on their own.

method.name: get_time_left
method.description: Returns the seconds left, or [code]0[/code] if stopped.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts (or restarts) the countdown. If [param time] is not negative, it replaces [member time].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the countdown starts when the node enters the scene.
If [code]true[/code], frees the parent node; otherwise only this node.
Seconds before the node is freed.

signal.name: expired
signal.description: Emitted right before freeing the node.
